issues.on_page: Other revenue 3,068,968 (operating revenues, below Total sales)
issues.issue: Kept as other, which is defensible: the report does not count it in sales. The FY2025 Electric JSON puts Other revenue (and the energy sales lines) in charges for services/fees while FY2023 uses Utility Charges / other, so the categories differ between years.
Interfund receivable; Internal Balances or receivables could fit. Matches FY2025.
Current compensated absences are Accrued Liabilities but noncurrent compensated absences (liabilities[5], 1,528,444) are other liabilities; same split in FY2025. Defensible but inconsistent.
